evals.prompt: Create repository knowledge docs for the fixture repo in evals/files/create-basic. Keep the output compact and evidence-backed.
evals.expected_output: A minimal knowledge set that creates only documents whose value tests pass, uses source and manifest evidence for current-state claims, and reports unknowns instead of guessing.
assertions: Created documents satisfy the document-contract value tests instead of creating placeholders
CONTEXT.md is not created when candidate terms are safely recoverable from obvious source and test names
Runnable commands are traced to package.json scripts before publication
Domain and source-navigation facts cite behavior-bearing source or focused tests
The final report includes mode, changed files, decisive evidence, unknowns, and checks when applicable

evals.prompt: Refresh the existing knowledge docs in evals/files/refresh-stale after source paths changed. Preserve supported human-authored guidance and correct stale current-state claims.
evals.expected_output: A refresh that limits changes to affected stale facts, keeps supported local guidance, corrects stale paths and commands from current source evidence, and reports the baseline or lack of reliable baseline.
assertions: Supported human-authored guidance remains intact
Stale paths are corrected or removed only after checking current repository evidence
The diff avoids unrelated wording, ordering, or formatting churn
The report identifies the refresh baseline used or states that no reliable baseline existed

evals.prompt: Perform a CODE-MAP-only refresh for evals/files/code-map-only so navigation points match the current source tree. Leave all other knowledge documents unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Only CODE-MAP.md changes; AGENTS.md and ARCHITECTURE.md remain byte-for-byte unchanged while stale navigation entries are updated from source evidence.
assertions: No knowledge document except CODE-MAP.md is modified
Every retained CODE-MAP.md link resolves with exact path case
Generated or special-handling areas identify both edit source and visible output when present
The report explicitly confirms CODE-MAP-only isolation was checked

evals.prompt: Refresh architecture knowledge for evals/files/conflicted-intent. Existing docs describe a target event stream, but current source implements synchronous HTTP calls.
evals.expected_output: Current behavior is documented from source evidence, contradicted target architecture remains only as labelled unresolved intent, and the conflict is reported as a stale or unresolved claim.
assertions: Current-state architecture claims prefer behavior-bearing source over prose
Contradicted human-authored intent is preserved only when labelled as unresolved intent
The report names the implementation conflict and what evidence would resolve it
No equal-authority conflict is resolved by guessing

evals.prompt: Create repository knowledge docs for evals/files/insufficient-evidence.
evals.expected_output: No knowledge documents are created because the fixture lacks a manifest, entry point, build or executable script, and behavior-bearing source file. The report states the insufficient evidence gate and the inspected scope.
assertions: The sufficiency gate is applied before drafting
No AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, or CODE-MAP.md placeholder is created
The report names the missing repository signals and the inspected scope

evals.prompt: Refresh the knowledge docs in evals/files/duplicate-facts. The duplicated test command should have one durable owner.
evals.expected_output: The runnable test command remains owned by AGENTS.md, the duplicate command is removed or replaced with an owner link outside AGENTS.md, and the consolidation is reported.
assertions: Runnable commands follow the document ownership table
The duplicated durable command fact has a single owner after refresh
The report includes a consolidation entry naming the affected fact
Current-state source facts remain backed by source or focused tests

evals.prompt: Refresh repository knowledge for evals/files/nested-inventory. Preserve nested agent guidance and ADR rationale that still match current source evidence.
evals.expected_output: The inventory includes the root guide, nested service guide, and ADR. Materially different nested guidance is retained, ADR rationale is linked or preserved as the decision owner, and source-navigation facts point to current files.
assertions: Nested AGENTS.md and ADR files are inventoried before drafting
Nested guidance with materially different completion checks is retained
ADR rationale remains owned by the ADR instead of being duplicated into ARCHITECTURE.md
Stale CODE-MAP.md paths are corrected from current source evidence
